g.title: note
g.text: Each colored product box belongs to a private subrepository; desktop groups three build entry points.
Arrows: consumer → dependency. Dashed: runtime / test use.
Source commits are locked. Binary hashes and compatibility require real builds.
FLASHApp also needs a separate FLASHTnT artifact, absent from this OpenMS baseline.
